summary: Braskem filed a 6-K disclosing ongoing negotiations with senior securities and debenture holders for a possible reorganization of its capital structure (Restructuring). The Company provided non-public Shared Information under confidentiality agreements dated June 11, 2026. Braskem and investors exchanged proposals (Braskem Proposal, Investors Proposal) without reaching agreement; the Company rejected the Investors' proposed terms. Braskem seeks a consensual, extrajudicial reorganization proceeding in Brazil to address short-term needs. No specific financial terms, premium, or board recommendation are detailed. The filing indicates no deal yet—focus on whether consensual restructuring or a more formal proceeding emerges, with risk-arb angle in the outcome of capital structure negotiations.
